thread:
maya: Quick async — finalizing onboarding for zeta-3b. HF repo points to huggingface.co/redwood/zeta-3b, but I don't see a mirrored S3 path in the registry. Who owns the mirror and can confirm checksum + tokenizer note?
chris: I can take ownership of the mirror. I pushed a candidate to s3://redwood-models/zeta-3b/v1/ earlier today. Presign link is ready but will rotate creds before prod.
leo: Maya — tokenizer quirk: the HF tokenizer for zeta-3b pads with "<pad>" token id 1, but our serving tokenizer expects id 0 for pad. Need a mapping step or a patched tokenizer.json.
tanvi: Re: checksum — can we use sha256 for the weights tarball? Please include both md5 and sha256 in the manifest so registry+ingest can validate.
chris: Uploaded tarball + checksums. md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e, sha256: b6f0c9e3a2... (full in registry manifest). Manifest snippet I pushed:```json
{
  "model": "zeta-3b",
  "version": "v1",
  "weights": "s3://redwood-models/zeta-3b/v1/weights.tar.gz",
  "md5": "d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e",
  "sha256": "b6f0c9e3a2c4...",
  "tokenizer_patch": "tokenizer_fix_v1.json"
}
```
maya: Perfect — can you also add a note about tokenizer id remap to the manifest (so Private deployments can apply the patch automatically)?
chris: Yup, added `tokenizer_id_map` key with mapping {"hf_pad":1, "rw_pad":0}. Also set `compatible_with` to include runtime >= 2.4.
leo: One more: truncation side default is "right" on HF, but our evals expect left truncation for long prompts. Add `truncation_side`: "left" so serving runtime can set the tokenizer accordingly.
tanvi: For access: infra-bot, can you confirm registry IAM policy allows the ingest role to read the s3 path and the audit log shows the upload?
infra-bot: Audit note: upload for s3://redwood-models/zeta-3b/v1/ by chris at 2026-02-15T14:12:33Z. IAM: ingest-role has s3:GetObject on prefix redwood-models/zeta-3b/*, registry-service has s3:ListBucket on redwood-models. Presign TTL currently 24h.
maya: Thanks. Follow-ups: (1) chris — put the final presign in the ingest ticket; (2) leo — add tokenizer patch and test script in a small CI job; (3) tanvi — validate manifest schema against registry lint.
chris: Will do. pinging @eng-ml for any last blockers. :thumbsup:
leo: I'll add a tiny unit test that asserts pad id mapping + truncation behavior. Dropping it into the onboarding CI now.
tanvi: Running manifest lint now. If it passes I'll promote to staging.
maya: Awesome. If anything blocks, drop a short note here. Otherwise we'll plan a canary rollout to Dedicated next week.
chris: quick note — the tokenizer_patch is a small json diff; sample CLI to apply locally:```bash
rw-tokenizer-tool apply-patch --from huggingface/tokenizer.json --patch tokenizer_fix_v1.json --out patched-tokenizer.json
```
leo: thanks — will run that and report results.
maya: closing loop: once staging ingest + CI green, I'll request the onboarding checklist sign-off. :white_check_mark:
